recipes.name: Chicken Burrito Bowl
method: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions.
Cut the chicken breast into small pieces.
Season the chicken with paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a frying pan and cook the chicken thoroughly.
Drain and rinse the black beans and sweetcorn.
Chop the tomato, avocado and lettuce.
Place the cooked rice in a bowl.
Add the chicken, beans, sweetcorn, tomato, avocado and lettuce.
Sprinkle grated cheese over the top.
Serve and enjoy.

recipes.name: Shrimp Fried Rice
method: Cook the rice in advance and refrigerate it until chilled.
Chop the carrot, spring onions and garlic.
Heat sesame oil in a frying pan or wok.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and fully cooked.
Remove the shrimp and scramble the eggs in the pan.
Add the carrot, peas and garlic and cook until tender.
Add the chilled rice and stir fry until piping hot.
Return the shrimp to the pan and add soy sauce.
Mix everything together and add the spring onions.
Serve hot.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato and Mince
method: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Celsius.
Wash the sweet potato and pierce it with a fork.
Bake for 40 to 50 minutes until soft.
Chop the onion and garlic.
Heat olive oil in a frying pan.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened.
Add the beef mince and cook until browned and fully cooked.
Stir in the chopped tomatoes, paprika and mixed herbs.
Simmer the mince mixture for 10 minutes.
Slice open the baked sweet potato and spoon the mince over it.
Serve and enjoy.

recipes.name: Overnight Oats
method: Add the rolled oats to a jar or container.
Pour in the milk and add the Greek yoghurt.
Add chia seeds and honey.
Mix everything together until combined.
Cover the container and place it in the fridge overnight.
In the morning, remove the oats from the fridge.
Slice the banana and strawberries.
Top the oats with fruit and peanut butter.
Serve cold and enjoy.

recipes.name: Cinnamon Rolls
method: Mix the flour, instant yeast and sugar in a large bowl.
Add warm milk, melted butter and the egg.
Mix and knead the dough until smooth.
Cover the dough and leave it to rise for about one hour.
Roll the dough into a rectangle.
Spread softened butter over the dough.
Mix cinnamon and brown sugar and sprinkle over the butter.
Roll the dough tightly and cut it into equal pieces.
Place the rolls in a greased baking dish.
Cover and leave to rise for another 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown.
Mix icing sugar with milk to make the icing.
Drizzle the icing over the warm cinnamon rolls.
Serve and enjoy.
